density.how: Count what the user's content needs, take the densest category any count points to, then check the fit: step down if a label needs more than 2 lines, overlaps a connector or forces a gap below the spacing spec; step up if the larger sizes still fit with every gap intact. Larger is preferred when it fits.

counts.nodes: device or system boxes (title tag + icon)
counts.labels: every text item except the title: tags, device labels, arrow labels, notes

status.when: only when the user marks a flow as a status

arrows.other: Any other arrow colour is used only when the user defines it for that diagram; otherwise the default applies.

icons.source: Faclon architecture icon library: get_brand_guidelines(section: "assets", asset_category: "icons"). 199 icons in 14 groups (energy meters, gateways and nodes, sensors, PLCs, switches and LIUs, enclosures, machines, I/O Sense platform and more), exported from the Figma icons_architecture page.
icons.missing: If a device the user names has no icon in the library, ask the user; do not pick, draw or substitute icons.
